narrative.overview: YOUPASS × WORD ATLAS 4.0 unites the crisp, daylight-first commercial clarity of YouPass 4.0 with the structured bilingual lexical depth of Word-Atlas (7,298 illustrated words) and My-IELTS (3,674 dictation keywords, 538 reading synonyms, 179 listening paraphrases, and 100 writing structures). Every study module is a numbered wayfinding gate (01 through 06) arranged on a luminous Cloud Ice White (#F8FBFF) canvas with Pure Porcelain White (#FFFFFF) cards and Soft Sky-Blue (#F0F7FF / #E0F2FE) focal frames.
keyCharacteristics: Asymmetric 12-column Bento Studio architecture with numbered gate headers (01–06) integrated directly into section titles.
Cloud Ice White daylight ground (#F8FBFF) paired with Pure Porcelain White modules (#FFFFFF), Soft Sky-Blue focal headers (#F0F7FF / #E0F2FE), and Sky-Cerulean (#0284C7) primary actions.
Tri-voice typography combining geometric display signage (Archivo), native Vietnamese editorial legibility (Be Vietnam Pro), and tabular phonetic/telemetry precision (JetBrains Mono).
Semantic color coding across all 6 CEFR levels (A1–C2), FSRS memory rating intervals (Again, Hard, Good, Easy), and REVEAL: ON / HIDDEN self-testing states.

rules.name: The Unified Sky-Porcelain Rule
rules.body: Every page (/, /login, /roadmap, /pricing, /admin) uses #F8FBFF Cloud Ice ground and #FFFFFF / #F0F7FF surfaces with #DCEBFA hairlines — never dark charcoal slabs.

rules.name: The Focal Sky Wash Rule
rules.body: Soft Sky Wash (#E0F2FE / #F0F7FF) with #BAE6FD borders is reserved for Station 02 / Hôm Nay Học Gì, active filter headers, and inline passage dictionary cards so the primary learning task stands out immediately.

rules.name: The Single-Line Gate Header Rule
rules.body: Module numbers (01 /, 02 /, 03 /) are integrated directly into the heading line itself; never place a small uppercase kicker or eyebrow label above a heading.

rules.name: The Tabular Telemetry Rule
rules.body: Every counter, streak digit, countdown clock, XP score, and FSRS day interval uses JetBrains Mono with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

rules.name: The No-Nested-Card Rule
rules.body: A Bento module is a single architectural container; sub-sections inside it divide via 1px solid #DCEBFA hairlines and flush table rows, never boxed cards inside boxed cards.

dos: Do integrate section numbers (01 /, 02 /, 03 /) directly into the heading text on a single line.
Do use custom SVG flags and consistent stroke icons (lucide-react) for audio, streak, and navigation controls.
Do keep all surfaces in the unified #F8FBFF / #FFFFFF / #F0F7FF Sky-Blue & Pure White 4.0 palette and format all numeric telemetry with tabular-nums.
Do separate sub-regions inside Bento panels using 1px solid #DCEBFA hairlines and flush grid cells.
donts: Don't place small uppercase kicker or eyebrow labels above headings.
Don't use Unicode emojis (🔥, 🇬🇧, 🇺🇸, 🏆) anywhere in the interface.
Don't nest boxed cards inside boxed cards or add decorative linear-gradient grid backgrounds to the page body.
Don't use gradient text, hard offset neobrutalist shadows, or thick colored border-left / border-bottom stripes on rounded elements.
